description: This is a header file defining structures, constants, macros, and function prototypes for the STM32F7 series MCU's Flash HAL extension. It includes configurations for flash memory operations such as erasing sectors, programming option bytes, and managing flash protections, as well as related constants, types, and macros.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Function prototype for erasing flash memory sectors or mass erase based on the provided erase configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Function prototype for interrupt-based flash erase operation.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Function prototype for programming flash option bytes.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBGetConfig
methods.description: Function prototype to retrieve current configuration of flash option bytes.
